sources.title: Morganucodon oehleri, DigiMorph
sources.author: Rowe, Macrini, Luo; UTCT, 2003
sources.evidence: True adult IVPP8685 skull CT image inspected, labeled5mm bar. Long low cranial proportions; approximate32mm from image ruler. No mesh downloaded.
sources.rights: UTCT and credited contributors; private reference, no texture/scan reuse.

sources.title: Fossil Evidence on Origin of the Mammalian Brain, supporting materials
sources.author: Rowe, Macrini and Luo 2011
sources.evidence: FigureS1 realIVPP8685 CT dorsal/ventral/lateral/occipital views. Adult isolated skull, mature dental formula discussed. Figure composite scale not used for model size; use separately labeled DigiMorph image.
sources.rights: Authors/Science retained copyright, private reference only.

sources.title: Meet Morgie!
sources.author: Caroline Buttler, Museum Wales,2018; sculpture Bob Nicholls
sources.evidence: Institutional research-informed full living reconstruction inspected; low body, short limbs, elongated snout and slender furry tail. Artistic soft tissues and pigment not direct fossil evidence.
sources.rights: MuseumWales/Nicholls original rights; reference only, not copied geometry or texture.

sources.title: Reptile-like physiology in Early Jurassic stem-mammals
sources.author: Newham et al.2020
sources.evidence: Methods distinguish inferred skull/body dimensions, incomplete femoral composites and M.watsoni estimate21mm from M.oehleri comparisons. Do not apply21mm as a measured IVPP8685 length.
